_about: PROPOSED severity and priority rules for this research prototype (Agent 2). They are the researcher's own operational rules, not an official standard. The rule logic lives in tools.severity_rule_engine(); the descriptions, the impact factors and severity rules are read from this file.
principle: Severity measures operational impact on the beneficiary's ability to complete the digital service. Negative sentiment and star rating are recorded but NEVER raise severity on their own (rule S0).

service_completion.BLOCKED: The beneficiary cannot complete the service/task at all (e.g. cannot log in, payment not processed, app does not open).
service_completion.PARTIALLY_BLOCKED: The task fails sometimes, or can only be completed through a workaround (e.g. via the website).
service_completion.DEGRADED: The task can be completed but with friction (slowness, freezes, confusing UI, wrong language, missing convenience).
service_completion.NOT_AFFECTED: No effect on completing the service (suggestion, inquiry, praise, cosmetic remark).

scope.INDIVIDUAL: No signal that the problem repeats or affects others.
scope.RECURRING: The beneficiary reports the problem happens repeatedly (always, every time, more than once).
scope.WIDESPREAD: The text signals many users are affected (everyone, all users, many people).

risk_flags.FINANCIAL: Money paid/deducted, fees, invoices or refunds involved.
risk_flags.PERSONAL_DATA_SECURITY: Personal data, privacy or security exposure.
risk_flags.LEGAL_DEADLINE: Fines, violations, legal or official deadlines at risk.

severity_rules.rule: service_completion = BLOCKED AND (risk flag in {FINANCIAL, PERSONAL_DATA_SECURITY, SAFETY} OR scope = WIDESPREAD)
service_completion = BLOCKED (no qualifying risk/scope), OR service_completion = PARTIALLY_BLOCKED with any risk flag
service_completion = PARTIALLY_BLOCKED, OR DEGRADED with scope in {RECURRING, WIDESPREAD} or any risk flag
service_completion = DEGRADED (individual, no risk), OR NOT_AFFECTED
Sentiment intensity and star rating are reported for transparency but never change the severity level.

priority_note: Priority (P1-P4) is no longer derived from severity: Agent 2 uses the research-defined Impact x Urgency matrix in impact_urgency_matrix.json (informed by ITIL 4), capped by P-VERIFY.
